div.head: III Eg 7.2
div.ab: ⁊ gyf aðor oððe mǽg oþþe fremde þa rade forsace, gylde þam cynge hundtwelftig scill'.
⁊ gyf aðer oððe mæg oððe fremde þa ráde forsace, gylde þam cynge hundtwelftig scyll'.
Gif aðer oððe mæg oððe fremde þa rade forsace, gylde þam cynge hundtwelftig scill'.
Et si aliquis uel cognatus uel extraneus illuc ire negauerit, emendet regi CXX sol.
⁊ gif aðer oððe mæg oððe fremde ða rade forsace, gilde þam cyninge hundtwelftig scill'.
And if anyone, either kinsman or stranger, refuses to ride [against him], he shall pay the king 120 shillings.
If either kinsman or stranger refuses to go on that ride, he is to pay 120 shillings to the king.
Und wenn entweder ein Verwandter [des Verbrechers] oder ein Fremder diesen Zug verweigert, zahle er dem König 120 Schill.
And if either a kinsman [of the criminal] or a stranger refuses this riding, let him pay the king 120 shillings.
div.note: Here So breaks off. Liebermann compares II As 20.2; III Em 2.
